morning.caption:
Iran's Revolutionary Guard said three tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday. US Central Command had not responded and the claim is unverified. Qatar's prime minister is working to revive US and Iran talks. Brent fell 3.45% to $89.39.

Watch OPEC+ on November 29. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
The US Commerce Department added seven companies to its Entity List on Monday, including Alibaba's Singapore unit and Megaspeed, citing the risk of AI chips reaching unapproved buyers. Alibaba called it erroneous and plans to fight it. Singapore's prime minister said the country will not be a conduit to evade US controls. General information, not financial advice. evening.caption:
New York Fed President John Williams said inflation is still too high and expects it to end 2026 at 3.5%. He would not rule out rate hikes at consecutive meetings. Traders see about a 95% chance of a quarter point hike on December 9. Watch US PCE inflation on Wednesday. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com
